messages:
Leo Chen: hi everyone — Leo here (he/they), day one on Eng-SRE. based in HKT/GMT+8. quick q: who to ping if MDM invite doesn't show? need VPN access to staging, dockerhub creds for private images, and a buddy. fun fact: i do chinese calligraphy & make dumplings on weekends. :dumpling:

Mia (Buddy): welcome Leo!! :tada: Im Mia, your buddy for the month. Ill DM to schedule a 20-min intro and walk through the first-tasks (CLA, runbook readme, small infra bug).

Raj (IT): hey Leo  MDM invites usually go out automatically. If you dont see it: visit https://intranet.redwood/mdm-enroll and re-open Company Portal. For VPN access, request role `staging-vpn` in the access portal and paste the ticket ID here. For dockerhub private images, open service request (template: "docker-pull") and include the image names. Example command to paste your SSH pubkey: `cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub | pbcopy`.

Leo Chen: thanks Raj  i see the invite now. submitting VPN + docker tickets (ticket #S-8812). pasted ssh key to profile.

Hana (People Ops): welcome Leo :balloon: Welcome kit & sticker pack are en route. Laptop default is macbook pro 14"  reply if you prefer linux. New-hire orientation invite sent. ETA for hardware swaps is ~3 business days.

Sam G.: welcome to SRE team! :wave: we pair on on-call ramping Tue mornings. once youre in #eng-sre well add you to the rota as read-only until week 2. for first-week tasks check the onboarding checklist: https://intranet.redwood/sre/onboarding.

DevOpsBot: Reminder: join #eng-sre, #oncall, and #devex. New-repo checklist: https://git.internal/redwood/sre/README.md.

Mia (Buddy): sending calendar invite for 10:30 HKT tomorrow. ill share a small todo list so you can open a quick PR on day 2. also dumplings > everything. :yum:

Leo Chen: awesome  accepted invites, ticket S-8812 created, and appreciated! looking forward to pairing and to the dumpling debate. :sparkles:
